ui.chat.tags.auto_tag.note: Names a fork of a conversation, not software forking. Shown only while the Tags switch is on; the switch itself is on by default.

ui.chat.tags.auto_tag_help.role: View-options helper under the Auto-tag forked sessions switch
ui.chat.tags.auto_tag_help.note: Explains that only the reader's existing tag vocabulary is used and only when the fork is named. Do not promise new tags are created.

ui.chat.tags.discovery.role: accessible description for the Tags switch
ui.chat.tags.discovery.note: Screen-reader-only hint for the Group chats by tag switch. Command+Shift+L and Ctrl+Shift+L are literal key names; keep both. Tags… is the row menu item name.

ui.chat.tags.no_matches.note: query is the exact search input; retain the quoted interpolation.

ui.chat.tags.removed_all.note: Success toast after clearing every tag and the primary in one write.

ui.chat.tags.remove_all.note: Row-menu action. Count is DISTINCT assigned tags: singular removes one tag; plural removes all assignments.

ui.chat.tags.changed_elsewhere.note: 409 revision conflict; authoritative tags are refreshed, never silently retried.

ui.chat.tags.move_armed.note: Live announcement when a conversation row arms after a hold. Name is the conversation title.

ui.chat.tags.move_cancelled.note: Live announcement after Escape, blur, pointer cancellation, or an ineligible drop. No write.

ui.chat.tags.undo.note: Toast action restoring assignments with the revision returned by the original write.

ui.chat.tags.move_undone.note: Live announcement only after Undo succeeds.

ui.chat.tags.move_failed.note: Move-specific failure and retry guidance; never substitutes for the revision-conflict message.

ui.chat.tags.selection_count.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. selection count.

ui.chat.tags.create_name.note: Explicit standalone button outside listbox. Only activation creates; Enter in unmatched search never creates. name is user-authored, 1–24 Unicode code points.

ui.chat.tags.create_helper.note: Always visible below Create before activation. Registry creation is durable for all conversations, even when conversation assignment is cancelled.

ui.chat.tags.selection_limit.note: Assignment limit is eight, distinct from registry capacity of thirty-two. Selected options remain removable.

ui.chat.tags.registry_limit.note: Shared category registry capacity, not selection count. Only creation disabled; existing tags remain editable.

ui.chat.tags.name_long.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. name long.

ui.chat.tags.name_reserved.note: Literal ASCII name Untagged is reserved case-insensitively by server; do not translate this identifier to the localized empty-group label.

ui.chat.tags.create_failed.note: Registry creation failure, not assignment Apply; retry reloads authoritative registry before another write.

ui.chat.tags.remove_named.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. remove named.

ui.chat.tags.created_name.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. created name.

ui.chat.tags.selection_status.note: Polite live announcement after toggle/removal or primary change. name is resulting primary, or localized Untagged.

ui.chat.tags.remote.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. remote.

ui.chat.tags.renamed_name.note: Bounded tag dialog feedback. Preserve ICU arguments; names are user-authored and counts are nonnegative integers. renamed name.

ui.chat.tags.registry_changed.note: A live registry refresh removed/changed a draft tag. Surviving draft and assignment order retained.

ui.chat.tags.dropped_on.note: Toast after a conversation is dragged onto a tag group: the tag is ADDED (other tags stay) and becomes the group the conversation is shown under. Do not translate as "moved to".

ui.chat.tags.show_under.note: Sidebar tags v3: an anchored popover beside a chat row (224-280px wide), a 28px group subheader, or the tag footer under the chat list. Names are user-authored and may be long; counts are nonnegative integers. Preserve ICU arguments.
